_note: A sum qualifying under Income-tax Act, 2025 s.123 — Schedule XV para 1(q): "tuition fees (excluding any development fees or donation or payment of similar nature) paid by an individual to any University, college, school or other educational institution situated in India (at the time of admission or thereafter), for full time education of any two children of such individual" (Gazette 265620, p.562). D-130. Any two children; development fees and donations excluded — entry conditions.
